mapper.select: select r.id from router r left join permission_router pr on r.id = pr.router_id left join permission p on pr.permission_id = p.id where p.id = #{perId} and r.deleted = 0 and pr.deleted = 0 and p.deleted = 0

select r.id from router r left join permission_router pr on r.id = pr.router_id left join permission p on pr.permission_id = p.id left join permission_role pro on p.id = pro.permission_id left join role ro on pro.role_id = ro.id where ro.id = #{roleId} and r.deleted = 0 and pr.deleted = 0 and pro.deleted = 0 and ro.deleted = 0 and p.deleted = 0

select r.uri, r.method from router r left join permission_router pr on r.id = pr.router_id left join permission p on pr.permission_id = p.id left join permission_role pro on p.id = pro.permission_id left join role ro on pro.role_id = ro.id left join user u on ro.id = u.role_id where u.id = #{userId} and r.deleted = 0 and pr.deleted = 0 and pro.deleted = 0 and ro.deleted = 0 and u.deleted = 0
select id, name, uri, method, deleted, create_time, create_user, update_time, update_user from router where deleted = 0 order by create_time desc, update_time desc
